source_instruction: i would like a pattern 21 cake topper for a birthday party.
query: My cousin just got a rescue tabby cat that keeps knocking over her potted succulents off the windowsill, she’s been posting nonstop about how the little orange gremlin chews on the plant leaves too. I spent twenty minutes last night scrolling through silly cat videos of kitties stealing socks out of laundry baskets, and I almost burned my microwave popcorn because I was laughing so hard at one where a cat wore a tiny cowboy hat and fell off a couch. The neighbor down the hall mentioned they’re throwing a birthday party next weekend, I’ve heard picks marked 21 work really well when you’re sticking to a $20 budget in this section.
